_schema.description: Curated next-quarter guidance vs point-in-time consensus, keyed by ticker. The free Yahoo API does not carry these two numbers, so they are filled by hand (or extracted from the earnings-day press release / news) with source links. app/earnings.py reads this file, grades each entry (대폭상회/상회/소폭상회/부합/소폭하회/하회/대폭하회), and attaches it to the matching report-date row of /api/earnings/{ticker}.

entry_fields.report_date: YYYY-MM-DD — the earnings date at which the guidance was given (must equal the quarter's date in /api/earnings so it merges).
entry_fields.guided_period: Human label for the quarter being guided, e.g. 'FY26 Q3'.
entry_fields.metric: revenue | eps | gross_margin — which figure this entry compares.
entry_fields.guidance_mid: Company guidance midpoint (number). Required for grading.
entry_fields.guidance_low: Optional low end of the guided range.
entry_fields.guidance_high: Optional high end of the guided range.
entry_fields.consensus: Analyst consensus for the same metric/quarter AS OF the report date. Required for grading.
entry_fields.sources: List of source URLs the numbers came from.
